asked.item: why only monthly plans show on the pricing page

verdict.reason: The help pages confirm yearly billing still exists, explain that the pricing page sells monthly only, and give the Billing Portal steps to switch to yearly.

steps.text: Yearly billing is still offered; it has not been removed.
Yearly billing saves about 17% compared to paying month to month, since you pay for 10 months and get 12.
The pricing page only sells monthly plans, so switch to yearly from the Billing Portal instead.
Go to Settings > Billing, click View Billing Portal, click the purple Update subscription button next to your current plan, select the yearly option for the plan you want, and confirm the change.
